change_description: EW factor weights → Factor DB ICIR-proportional weights within Defense and TP Gap sleeves

delta_vs_parent.verdict: DOWNGRADE — IC-weight hurt performance due to Factor DB name mismatch

ic_weight_analysis.root_cause: Factor DB factor names don't match sleeve custom factors. IdioVol ICIR<0 in most periods. TPMom has no Factor DB match (ICIR=0). Result: single-factor concentration instead of diversified weighting.

lesson: L-547: Sleeve IC-Weight with Factor DB name-matching fails when custom factors have no exact DB counterpart. ICIR<0 exclusion turns multi-factor into single-factor. Need direct IC computation on sleeve's own factor scores, not Factor DB proxy.
